title: Note: AI docs consolidated, 54 flat files now in 12 subsystem folders

chat.text: Before: ai/doc had 31 flat docs and ai/sessions/doc 23. After: ai/doc has 7 subfolders (design, agents, tokens, logs, tasks, ai2, meta) and sessions/doc has 5 (asks, data, ui, live, cost), each with an index readme ([doc/readme.md](/framework/ai/doc/readme.md), [sessions/doc/readme.md](/framework/ai/sessions/doc/readme.md)). 20 duplicate or tiny docs were merged into 8 current ones; the originals sit unchanged in archive/ folders with a moved.md line saying where each went. Nothing deleted. The move was one script (consolidate.mjs plus moves.jsonl manifest, task folder ai/2026-10-09/ai-mastermind), which also rewrote every link; commits bbec8f981 and b9d948f03. 51 Haiku readers triaged the files first (one failed, the 52nd). Five rules worded as laws were softened. system/ holds only a model benchmark (models.json), not a map of the AI systems; it now has a readme saying so and pointing to the real map. The readme also linked a system/thinking/ page that does not exist; removed. Open: the System tab has no page for Servex agents, sessions or the page system.
